intent.premise: A thirty-one-second single-character healing short on a rainy school rooftop, built from approved 2D keyframes, 2D crop moves, energy-gated Chinese viseme cels for the girl's spoken lines, rain Foley, subtitles, and a gentle semantic score that lifts when the rain stops.
intent.audience: Viewers evaluating a compact but complete 2D anime short with a stable generated heroine, a consistent orange tabby cat, readable rainy-to-rainbow progression, and synchronized sound.
designPriorities: Keep the girl's waist-length dark-blue hair, amber eyes, white shirt, navy plaid pleated skirt, navy school bag, and transparent umbrella stable across every frame.
Keep the orange tabby cat's white chest, white paws, and green eyes stable as it dries off after the rain.
Use hard cuts for all beats so character and cat silhouettes never double through a dissolve; reserve the single closing crossfade for the final empty-rooftop shot.
Gate visible closed, half, and open mouth cels at 12 fps from the exact post-trim final dialogue stem, then select limited visemes from the known Chinese syllables, never from subtitle duration.
Derive frame selection, mouth state, crop motion, transitions, and subtitles only from absolute story time so seeks and segmented renders remain deterministic.
Preserve exactly one girl, one cat, one umbrella, and clear rooftop railing, puddle, and stairwell geography in every applicable shot.

intent.location: A Japanese school rooftop with rain-pooled concrete, surrounding iron railings, a distant city skyline, and a stairwell entrance, all baked into full-frame 2D artwork.
intent.timeOfDay: An overcast rainy afternoon that clears into luminous post-rain light with a rainbow for the final third.
intent.storyFunction: Establish the rain-soaked rooftop, let the girl discover a drenched cat by a cardboard box, share her umbrella at her own expense, and close on her decision to take the cat home as the sky clears.
visualRules: Every source PNG fills the 1920 by 1080 presentation canvas through cover-crop without aspect-ratio distortion.
The keyframe timeline, rather than equal frame division, determines every image boundary and camera-like crop move.
Each spoken line keeps one stable speaker plate; only a tight mouth rectangle changes between closed, half, and open states.
Chinese subtitles are rendered in code over text-free source art and must remain inside the lower safe area.
The scene uses a CanvasTexture as the Three.js background, so runtime camera collision geometry is intentionally inapplicable and camera obstacles remain empty.
Girl is a voice-only story speaker whose visible body is baked into the keyframes; no 3D character meshes may be layered over the artwork.

purpose: Represent the full-frame timed 2D presentation rather than a navigable 3D stage.

screenCenter.purpose: Stable center of the full-frame keyframe canvas.

bakedCatCorner.purpose: Semantic screen-right cardboard-box corner where the drenched cat hides, represented inside the generated artwork.

bakedStairwell.purpose: Semantic screen-left stairwell exit used by the closing walk-away shot, represented inside the generated artwork.

lighting.mood: Soft grey rainy-day diffusion clearing into transparent post-rain sunlight with a rainbow lift for the closing beats.
readabilityRules: Do not apply runtime lighting or grading that changes character colors between generated frames.
Keep faces, the navy and white costume silhouette, the orange cat, the transparent umbrella, and the rainbow readable during all crop motion and transitions.
Keep subtitle contrast independent of the baked background by using a dark translucent backing and outlined white text.

audioAnchors.semantic: Steady rain loop over the whole rooftop that fades once the sky clears.
Cat meows and purring from the cardboard-box corner.
Footsteps on wet concrete as the girl carries the cat toward the stairwell.

shotChecks.purpose: Confirm the empty rain-soaked rooftop, railings, and puddle reflections fill the first frame with subtitle-safe margins.
Confirm the girl with the transparent umbrella is readable in her full-figure entrance during the first monologue line.
Confirm the weakening rain and first sunbeam read clearly as the girl announces the clearing sky.
Confirm the girl begins the final take-home line on camera with syllable-aware visemes before she lifts the cat.
